# What this document is for

Three indexes are declared and exactly one marker is written, for the LAST of
them. So the third index prints where its marker stands, in the middle of the
document, and the two no marker names are appended at the end — in the order
they were declared, which is the one place declared order is the rule rather
than a coincidence of where the markers were written.

The section order on the page is therefore Third, First, Second: neither the
declared order nor the marker order, but what the two rules together say.

One term files in each index: [Alpha term]{.index index="alpha"},
[Beta term]{.index index="beta"}, [Gamma term]{.index index="gamma"}.
